change: The game profile's plumbing and its first role. Engine: OriginalIDSet (literal IDs and a bit array; contains equals the literal list's answer for every Int32) and OriginalGameRules (profile, reflectable), carried OriginalContentIdentity.rules -> OriginalApplicationCatalogInputs.rules (kept by replacingFile) -> the catalog session's Resources/Inputs -> OriginalLoadedCatalog.rules (every constructor requires it) -> OriginalHitPass/OriginalContactPass `let rules` (from the catalog copy their constructors already take; required rules: on the explicit-provider entry points).
